localizedDescriptions.zh: Cloudflare Workers / Pages 观测：账户限额（Workers Free 每日 / Workers Paid 每月）、项目请求 / CPU / 错误分析、Workers Observability 日志查询，桌面与锁屏小组件显示选定项目的限额使用。

name: Cloudflare Observability
description: Cloudflare Workers / Pages observability: account quota (Workers Free daily / Workers Paid monthly), per-project requests / CPU / errors, Workers Observability log queries, and Home / Lock Screen widgets for the selected project's quota usage.
